description: Previously winning cases from the formal balance v6 free-skills matrix. Only these cases are required to remain victories; the five original losses are excluded.

source.method: 8 current ultimates × 2 forms × 6/8 subject points × 3 stages × 10 paired seeds. Total points follow operationProfile; fixed squad per owner, subject captain.
